faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.intro: Quick answers about learning and creating courses on Midroc Learning.

gettingStarted.question: How do I start learning?
gettingStarted.answer: Create a free account with your email or Google account, browse courses by category or language, and enroll in a course.

languages.question: What languages are courses in?
languages.answer: Courses are taught in English or Amharic. Each course page shows its language.

progress.question: How do I track my learning progress?
progress.answer: Your enrolled courses and progress appear under My learning, where you can return to a course and continue.

courseCreation.question: Can I create and share a course?
courseCreation.answer: Yes. Anyone with an account can create a course. An administrator reviews it before it is published.

share.title: Share what you know
share.body: Anyone with an account can create a course. Administrators review it before it goes live.
